name: Bladeguard
benefit: This clear resin protects a weapon from harmful attacks made by oozes and rust monsters, as well as other corrosive effects.

name: Fire Ward Gel
benefit: When applied it creates a resistant barrier that protects from fire, reduces all fire damage by 3.

name: Frost Ward Gel
benefit: When applied it creates a resistant barrier that protects from cold, reduces all cold damage by 3.

name: Smelling Salts
benefit: These sharply scented gray crystals cause people inhaling them to regain consciousness.

name: Troll Oil
benefit: This crimson liquid is viscous and foul, drinking it stablizes you should you fall to 0 hit points.

name: Wismuth Salix
benefit: This pink liquid has a horrible chalky taste, but counteracts the effects of nausea and sickness.

name: Alchemist's Acid
benefit: Volatile liquids swirl chaotically in the flask, when thrown deals 1d3 acid damage to a target creature or object.

name: Alchemist's Fire
benefit: Volatile liquids swirl chaotically in the flask, when thrown deals 1d3 fire damage to a target creature or object.

name: Bottled Lightning
benefit: Electricity crackles slong a metal filament inside this small glass bottle, when thrown deals 1d3 electrical damage to target creature.

name: Flash Powder
benefit: This coarse gray powder ignites and burns instantly, when thrown DC11 CON or creature is blinded.

name: Holy Water
benefit: Pure waster mixed with silver flakes, when thrown deals 1d6 damage to undead creatures.

name: Tanglefoot Bag
benefit: This small sack is filled with tar and other sticky substances, when thrown DC11 DEX or creature is held in place.
